name: Takara Sushi (Logan, UT) Grilled Yellowtail Collar (Hamachi Kama) & White Rice
whyItWorks: A chef's secret gem! Grilled Hamachi collar is extraordinarily tender, juicy, and packed with anti-inflammatory omega-3 fatty acids without any breading, dairy, or harsh spices.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Hamachi Kama grilled with sea salt, served with steamed white sticky rice (hold citrus ponzu sauce upon request).
watchOuts: None; pristine flare-safe Japanese seafood entree
